notes: Buy a myki at 7-Eleven. The centre is a Free Tram Zone, and the SkyBus airport transfer costs 22 AUD. For the Great Ocean Road, Phillip Island and Yarra Valley, take a tour or hire a car (they drive on the left).
December to February is summer at 25-35°C, with hot northerly winds bringing 40°C days. The Australian Open is in January and the F1 in March. March to May, in autumn, is best.
Coffee culture is among the world's best: try a flat white or a magic. Brunch costs 25-30 AUD and tours 130-150 AUD. Tipping is not expected.
Book the Penguin Parade online, and note that photography is not allowed. The light at the Twelve Apostles is best in the afternoon. Queen Vic Market is closed Monday to Wednesday.
Laneways to see: Hosier, ACDC, Centre Place and Degraves. For street art, head to Fitzroy and Collingwood, and Sydney Road in Brunswick.
UV is high in summer, so wear sunscreen. Tap water is safe to drink.

transit.name: myki
transit.why_chosen: Covers trams, trains and buses. Trams in the centre are FREE (Free Tram Zone), and the daily cap is about 11 AUD.

stops.name: Hosier Lane
stops.tips: A graffiti lane that changes daily, next to ACDC Lane.

stops.name: Degraves Street Breakfast
stops.tips: Laneway cafes serving flat whites and avocado toast, near Centre Place.

stops.name: State Library Victoria La Trobe Reading Room
stops.tips: An octagonal reading room, free to enter. Look out for Ned Kelly's armour.

stops.name: Federation Square & ACMI
stops.tips: ACMI, the film museum, is free. The Ian Potter NGV showcases Australian art, and the Yarra riverbank is right there.

stops.name: Lune Croissanterie Fitzroy
stops.tips: Billed as the world's best croissant. Take tram 11 to Fitzroy and expect a queue.

backups.name: Higher Ground Breakfast
backups.tips: Brunch in a former power station on Little Bourke Street.

backups.name: Melbourne Museum Carlton
backups.tips: Natural history and an Aboriginal gallery, next to the Royal Exhibition Building. A swap for ACMI.

stops.name: Queen Victoria Market
stops.tips: A market dating from 1878. Try the American Doughnut Kitchen van and the cheese and deli hall. The summer night market runs on Wednesdays. Closed Monday and Wednesday.

stops.name: Royal Exhibition Building & Carlton Gardens
stops.tips: A UNESCO-listed exhibition hall from 1880, with fountains and gardens.

stops.name: Lygon Street
stops.tips: Little Italy: Brunetti pastry shop and Pellegrini's, where Melbourne's coffee scene began.

stops.name: Fitzroy Brunswick Street
stops.tips: Vintage shops, street art and the Rose Street Artists' Market at weekends.

stops.name: Naked for Satan Rooftop Bar
stops.tips: A Fitzroy rooftop with city sunset views and pintxos.

backups.name: Pellegrini's Espresso Bar
backups.tips: An espresso bar unchanged since 1954, on Bourke Street.

backups.name: Melbourne Zoo
backups.tips: A zoo in Royal Park. A swap for Fitzroy if you're travelling with children.

stops.name: Bells Beach
stops.tips: Take a tour leaving at 06:30 (130 AUD) or drive. A legendary surf beach at Torquay.

stops.name: Kennett River Koala Walk
stops.tips: Wild koalas and parrots in the trees, along Grey River Road.

stops.name: Apollo Bay
stops.tips: A fishing town known for fish and chips and calamari.

stops.name: Twelve Apostles
stops.tips: Limestone stacks (8 remain). Gibson Steps lead 86 steps down to the beach. The light is best in the afternoon.

stops.name: Loch Ard Gorge
stops.tips: A shipwreck cove with caves, 3 minutes from the Apostles. Allow 3 hours for the return.

backups.name: Cape Otway Lightstation
backups.tips: The oldest lighthouse on mainland Australia. A swap for Apollo Bay.

stops.name: Brighton Bathing Boxes
stops.tips: 82 colourful huts on Dendy Street Beach. Take the train to Middle Brighton. Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: St Kilda Esplanade & Pier
stops.tips: Take tram 96 to the pier and the Luna Park laughing mouth. Little penguins appear at sunset (under the pier).

stops.name: Acland Street Cake Shops
stops.tips: Monarch Cakes (1934) and European patisseries, a legacy of Jewish immigrants.

stops.name: Luna Park Melbourne
stops.tips: A funfair from 1912. Entry is free, and the Scenic Railway wooden roller coaster costs 15 AUD.

stops.name: St Kilda Pier Penguins
stops.tips: Little penguins on the breakwater at sunset. No flash photography, and volunteers are on hand.

backups.name: Stokehouse St Kilda
backups.tips: A stylish restaurant right on the beach.

backups.name: Jewish Museum of Australia
backups.tips: St Kilda's Jewish museum. A swap for the garden.

stops.name: Brighton to Phillip Island and Churchill Island
stops.tips: Take a tour leaving at 12:00 (130 AUD, penguins included) or drive for 2 hours. See the historic farm and a sheep shearing show.

stops.name: Koala Conservation Reserve
stops.tips: See koalas from treetop boardwalks.

stops.name: Cape Woolamai Coastal Walk
stops.tips: A pink granite headland and surf beach, with the Pinnacles.

stops.name: The Nobbies & Seal Rocks
stops.tips: Rocky cliffs, seagull colonies and fur seals. Bring binoculars.

stops.name: Penguin Parade
stops.tips: At sunset, thousands of little penguins waddle from the sea to their burrows. Book tickets online. Photography is NOT allowed, and bring a coat.

backups.name: Penguin Parade Cafe
backups.tips: In the visitor centre, serving fish and soup.

backups.name: Panny's Chocolate Factory
backups.tips: A chocolate factory. A swap for the koalas if you're travelling with children.

stops.name: Yarra Valley Dairy
stops.tips: Cheese tasting at Yering.

stops.name: Domaine Chandon Yarra Valley
stops.tips: Sparkling wine tasting with vineyard views. Take a tour (about 150 AUD) or drive for 1 hour.

stops.name: Healesville Sanctuary
stops.tips: Native animals including kangaroos, platypuses and wombats, plus a bird show.

stops.name: Yering Station
stops.tips: A winery on a historic farm, with pinot noir and views.

backups.name: TarraWarra Estate
backups.tips: Wine plus an art museum. A swap for Yering.

backups.name: Innocent Bystander Healesville
backups.tips: Pizza and wine in the town centre.

stops.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
stops.tips: 38 hectares of gardens, with the Ornamental Lake and views of the Shrine of Remembrance.

stops.name: Shrine of Remembrance
stops.tips: See the city from the memorial balcony. Free entry.

stops.name: Southbank Promenade
stops.tips: The Yarra riverbank. Eureka Skydeck (30 AUD) is optional.

stops.name: Southgate Breakfast-Lunch
stops.tips: Riverside views and a farewell flat white.

stops.name: Southern Cross SkyBus
stops.tips: SkyBus to Tullamarine takes 30 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Eureka Skydeck
backups.tips: The 88th floor and the Edge glass box.

backups.name: Ponyfish Island
backups.tips: A floating bar-cafe under the bridge.
